Initial release of Video Editing and AI — Edit and Export AI Videos:

- Instantly edit and export AI-powered videos by uploading footage and describing your editing goals.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM uploads up to 500MB; all video processing runs on cloud GPU nodes.
- Automatic token and session setup streamlines onboarding—no configuration needed.
- Handles user prompts for cut, transitions, export, credits, and more via intent classification.
- Exports videos in multiple formats (mp4, mov, avi, webm, mkv, jpg, png, gif, webp, mp3, wav, m4a, aac).
- Provides clear status updates, error handling, and step-by-step workflows tailored for content creators and marketers.
